hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0001 = D[p,q]F = (F(p)-F(q))/(p-q) = (s(p)-s(q))/(p-q); G0002 = D[p,p]F = F'(p), identified with ds(p).
required_assumptions: ds(p) is interpreted as the derivative of s at p
F(z)=s(z) is sufficiently smooth at the repeated node p
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The two catalog members are the generic two-point divided difference and the repeated-node diagonal value of the same underlying function s, forming a standard divided-difference/derivative family.
